rawContent: I’m uncomfortable with this news story because it quickly takes the focus off of Buffalo and brings it back to COVID, under the guise of mass death. Nah, keep that light on Black Lives. #BlackLivesMatter STILL!

I’m just retweeting this because I want folks to be clear that the attacks on & denigration of #BlackLivesMatter (and they still do, btw) are largely to demoralize us as a people and to get us not to believe in ourselves and our just cause. #DontBelieveTheHype #January6thHearings
